Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Both of you agree on the central measurement, and on that measurement no money moves.

THE DISTANCE TEST (POL-RD-01). The route was measured on the GPS trace EV-GPS-00102, which governs over the rounded copy on the trip record. The trace length is 21.79 km against a booked optimal of 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102) — an excess of 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km. The 0.8 km limb passes at 1.39 km, but the percentage limb fails at 6.81%, and both must pass. No deviation is therefore established, and POL-RD-01's closing sentence applies: the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. The rider's advocate conceded this candidly and correctly, and the driver's advocate's reading of the same figures is accepted.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To the rider and to the driver: this dispute is about the route taken on trip TRP-00102 (Woodlands to ION Orchard), and it turns on one measurement. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace, not the rounded figure on the trip record, the governing distance. The trace is 21.79 km long (EV-GPS-00102); the booked optimal route is 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102). The excess is 1.39 km, which is 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The 1.39 km excess clears the 0.8 km absolute limb, but 6.81% falls far short of the 20% limb, and both tests must pass. No route deviation is therefore established. POL-RD-01's closing sentence is explicit: where either test fails, the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The rider's preference for the BKE, and the 32-minute duration against a normal 27, engage no threshold in the policy — POL-RD-01 is a distance test, not a duration test — so the present payment state stands. The trace itself is unimpaired for policy purposes (EV-GPS-00102: 193 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0 seconds). POL-RD-07's impairment consequences, and the independent-corroboration requirement that follows, do not arise, and neither does any escalation on that ground. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02 is not engaged. The $27.46 recomputed fare and the $2.45 difference precomputed on the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00102) play no part in this ruling; no distance-and-time refund issues. Your charge of $29.91 (of which $7.00 was contested) stands as charged. There is likewise no billing-integrity correction to make: the fare carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, and the billed distance (21.8 km) is not below the traced distance (21.79 km), so no driver compensation under POL-RD-04 arises. The driver's explanation — that the BKE was crawling near Dairy Farm so he came off via Upper Thomson — is not supported by any record on file. The traffic advisory for this trip window is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-00102-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), and no advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor for 11:16–11:55 on 19 July 2026. Under POL-RD-13 read with POL-RD-08, that assertion carries no weight and can neither excuse the excess nor supply an amended optimal route. This does not change the outcome, which fails on the distance measurement alone, and it does not trigger escalation: the driver cited no advisory identifier, so POL-RD-13(1) applies and the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact under POL-RD-10(5). The single chat message (EV-CHAT-00102) is the driver's own, sent during the trip, and carries no waypoint hint. It is not a rider instruction, so the rider-requested-detour exoneration in POL-RD-04 is unavailable to the driver on this record — though nothing turns on it, since no deviation was established to exonerate. Both advocates' distance analyses are accepted on this point: the driver's reading of POL-RD-01, POL-RD-02, POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-08, and the rider's candid concession that the 6.81% excess does not meet the 20% limb, all point the same way. The rider's separate observation that the 1.39 km excess clears the 0.8 km limb is correct but insufficient, because the percentage limb independently fails. For the record: no referral fires. POL-RD-06(c) requires a material deviation and an established repeat pattern (the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 640 completed trips in 90 days), POL-RD-09(4) requires a phantom or unmatched charge line (there is none), and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07 concern no-show matters not present here. The monetary effect is nil, well below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, and this ruling is provisional and appealable under POL-GEN-04.

This is a route-deviation dispute for the trip from Blk 888 Woodlands Dr 50 to ION Orchard on 19 July 2026. Both sides filed claims that the referee kept in full; nothing was discarded at the mechanical stage, and I have added nothing of my own to that ledger. Identification first (POL-RD-08(a)). EV-TRIP-00102, EV-GPS-00102 and EV-FARE-00102 all carry trip_id TRP-00102 and the trace's first fix (2026-07-19T11:23:30+08:00) matches the trip record's started_at, so this is one trip and the debate runs on this trip's own evidence. Both advocates are right on this point and I accept it. The measurement (POL-RD-01). The governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 21.79 km; the trip record's 21.8 km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and is not used for the threshold test. Against the booked optimal of 20.4 km the excess is 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH an excess greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The 1.39 km clears the absolute limb (0.8 km), but 6.81% falls far short of the 20% limb, so the establishment test fails and no deviation exists. The rider advocate's candour on this is correct; the driver advocate's reading (the platform's derived status 'no deviation', the 6.9% figure on the trip record) reaches the same result, and the trip record's deviation_pct is not needed to get there. POL-RD-01's closing sentence then governs: where either establishment test fails, the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. I accept the rider's account that the trip felt long — the trace does show the vehicle on the Mandai / Upper Thomson side — but the policy gate is numeric and it is not crossed. The duration point (32 minutes against a 27-minute estimate) engages no threshold in POL-RD-01, which is a distance test; I accept the driver advocate's claim on that. Refund arithmetic. POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01. None is, so the recomputed_fare of $27.46 and the refund figure of $2.45 carried on EV-FARE-00102 are not engaged and no refund of that figure (or of the $7.00 the rider contested) issues. The payment of $29.91 stands as charged. Billing integrity (POL-RD-09(4)). I have checked independently because that limb is available whether or not a deviation exists. The fare breakdown carries no ERP lines (erp_lines total $0.00, erp_gantries empty) and no airport surcharge ($0.00 on a trip that does not originate at an airport), so no charge line lacks a counterpart and no billing-integrity finding arises. Exculpatory routes. The driver's explanation — that the BKE was crawling near Dairy Farm so he came off via Upper Thomson — is a traffic assertion, and the only artifact that could test it, EV-ADVIS-00102-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT); no advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor for this trip's window. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 that assertion carries no weight and its absence neither excuses nor reduces any excess, and I record that no advisory was on file. This does not escalate the case: the driver cited no advisory ID, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, and in any event the measurements already dispose of the case without it. On the chat log, the only message is the driver's own unanswered 'boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?' with no waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04 (rider-requested detour) is unavailable; I accept the rider advocate's claim on this. Escalation check. The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 193 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds. Nothing in POL-RD-10 fires. Confidence is capped by the artifacts that actually carry the deciding fact — the trace at weight 1.0 and the trip record at weight 1.0 — so the cap is 1.0, and I set confidence at 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No referral is produced: POL-RD-06(c) needs a MATERIAL deviation (over 50% or over 8.0 km), which is nowhere near on these figures, and POL-RD-09(4) has found nothing to record. Outcome. The rider's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands: the $29.91 charge is left in place and no refund moves. The monetary effect is nil, so POL-GEN-05's execution threshold ($8.00) is not reached. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.
